title: Skills
subtitle: Manage reusable skills, content structures, and creation styles.
pinnedHint: Project selections keep their exact versions. Editing creates a new version. Export includes the complete original package.
disabledPreview: Enable this resource to build a new preview. Previous build records are retained.
skillScopeHint: Preview shows reusable structure or instructions, not a generated result. The default applies to this skill package version; saved tasks keep their frozen selections.
adapterMissing: The management adapter for this resource is unavailable.
approveSelected: I approve this exact source, version, selection, and permissions.
nativeImportHint: Import a JSON package, theme ZIP, or PowerPoint file. Archives open source review; installation requires your approval.
portableImportHint: Install the selected definitions and resources. This does not run instructions, grant permissions, or publish content.
portablePreviewHint: Preview shows the saved definition. Installing a new version keeps the existing default; use Set as default to switch. Existing documents and tasks keep their selected versions.
siteProfileIllustration: Typography and color illustration. This is not an engine-built website preview.
draftConflict: This draft changed in another window. Reload it before saving or publishing a version.
draftNotFound: This draft is unavailable or was removed.
unsupportedAuthoring: An editor is not available for this skill format.
approveTemplateVersion: I approve this exact resource, license, and immutable version.
instructionsHint: Instructions stay separate from the article body and are not executed when saving a skill.
noDrafts: You have no writing skill drafts.
placeholderHint: Use the insert button to place a parameter or content slot in the document. Keep its ID consistent when editing.
recoveryUnavailable: Browser recovery is unavailable. Save the draft before closing.
releaseHint: Add this immutable version to this installation's shared skill library. This does not change project documents or publish an article.
reloadSavedHint: Resolve any pending save, then replace the working copy with the saved draft. Unsaved local edits will be discarded.
removeDraftHint: Remove this working draft. Published skill versions are retained.
saveUncertain: The save response was lost. Retry to confirm the same operation.
savedInBrowser: Changes kept in this browser; draft not yet saved
unknownPlaceholder: A placeholder has no matching parameter or content slot. Update its ID or add the missing definition.
documentApplicationHint: Choose a saved skill, fill its fields, then continue in the document editor. Content slots accept Markdown; place lists and tables in a separate skill paragraph.
noDocumentTemplates: No writing skills are available. Add or enable one in Skills → Writing.
invalidApplicationValues: Check the required fields and content format. Lists and tables need a separate content-slot paragraph in the skill.
nativeApprovalRequired: Approve the exact theme code permission and acknowledge its license before installing.
nativeStorageFull: Installed theme storage is full. Contact the administrator before retrying.
nativeSourceIncomplete: Some files under this theme root were not captured. Read a complete source before installing.
nativePrivateHint: This theme is private to your account. Installation keeps its original source and does not publish a website.
nativeEntry: Theme entry relative to the selected root
nativeDependenciesHint: Use exact versions available in the administrator-managed build image. Importing a theme never runs npm install or its package scripts. Missing packages must be added to the build image before building.
nativeCodeHint: This theme contains executable build code. Approve only a source you trust. Builds use the configured isolated worker.
nativeApproveCode: I approve executing this exact theme code in the isolated build worker.
nativeApproveLicense: I have read the license and confirm that I may use this theme.
nativeExportTooLarge: The theme is too large to export as a re-importable ZIP.
nativeExportHint: The ZIP contains the selected theme files, license and README. It does not include unrelated source files or execution approval. Re-import creates a new source copy; use a new ID or version if that version is already installed.
nativeBundleHint: This package restores skill settings and verified files. Review its license and code permission again before installing. Its original approval and installed state are not transferred.
officeInvalidMapping: Select supported text or image objects from the selected original.
officeUnsupportedPackage: This PowerPoint package type is not supported. Use a regular POTX or PPTX file.
officeLimit: The PowerPoint source or metadata exceeds the supported limit.
officePartUnavailable: The selected layout or slide is unavailable.
officeLicenseRequired: Read the license and confirm your right to install this skill.
officeInvalidPackage: The PowerPoint skill, resources or mapping could not be verified.
officePrivateHint: Your private PowerPoint original, mapping and license are versioned together. Downloads retain the original files.
officeMappingHint: Choose a layout or slide, then map its editable text or image objects. Structure inspection does not show the rendered appearance.
officeNoObjects: No supported editable objects in this part.
officeMappedCount: {count, plural, one {# mapped slot} other {# mapped slots}}
officeCustomize: Customize as a new skill version
officeRetainHint: Install this bundle unchanged to preserve its original mapping and file identity. Enable customization to create a different version.
officeLicenseAcknowledged: I have read the license and have the right to install and use this skill.
officeEmptySelection: Choose a layout or slide to inspect.
emptyLibraryHint: Import a skill file, or add a GitHub source from the menu above. Installed skills appear in this category.
emptyFilterHint: Try another search or clear the filters to see more.
resourceEmptyHint: Import a theme or channel layout to get started.
resourceEmptyFilterHint: Try another search or clear the filters.
